decisions.why: electroencephalography monitoring (TruScan range: NeuroTablet, Telemetry, ICU, Routine EEG Portable/Desktop) is a specialist physiological patient-monitoring modality, distinct from routine multi-parameter vital-signs monitoring
intraoperative neuromonitoring (Cynapse IONM Portable/Desktop) is specialist patient monitoring during surgery
electromyography/nerve-conduction monitoring (TruTrace EMG-NCS-EP Portable/Desktop) is a specialist physiological monitoring modality
polysomnography/sleep monitoring (SomniPro NeuroTablet, Telemetry, Portable, Desktop) is specialist patient monitoring, not routine vital-signs monitoring
